candidate_sentences.text: Infortar Group reported a significant improvement in profitability in the first half of 2026 despite broadly stable revenue.
Six-month revenue decreased 0.6% year on year to EUR 945.9 million, while EBITDA increased 30.8% to EUR 111.2 million and the EBITDA margin rose from 8.9% to 11.8%.
Operating profit almost doubled, increasing 93.6% to EUR 51.1 million.
Profit before tax rose to EUR 27.2 million from EUR 2.7 million, and the Group generated net profit of EUR 7.2 million compared with a EUR 14.4 million loss in the prior-year period.
The Group invested approximately EUR 50 million during the first half.

verified_key_information_units.information: H1 2026 segment EBITDA was EUR 39.3 million for maritime transport (vs EUR 33.3 million in H1 2025), EUR 59.9 million for energy (vs EUR 51.7 million), and EUR 6.5 million for real estate (vs EUR 4.4 million). Supporting segments contributed EBITDA of EUR 5.6 million, improving from a loss of EUR -4.4 million in H1 2025.

candidate_sentences.text: The improvement reflected stronger performance across all segments, particularly supporting businesses, which moved from a EUR 4.4 million EBITDA loss in the first half of 2025 to EUR 5.6 million of EBITDA in 2026.
Energy EBITDA increased to EUR 59.9 million from EUR 51.7 million, while maritime transport EBITDA rose to EUR 39.3 million from EUR 33.3 million.
Real estate EBITDA increased to EUR 6.5 million from EUR 4.4 million.

verified_key_information_units.information: In Q2 2026, Tallink Grupp carried 1,454,725 passengers (-2.2% YoY), 68,986 cargo units (+2.9%), and 199,025 passenger vehicles (-6.5%). The segment reported a net loss of EUR 2.5 million (unchanged YoY), impacted by higher fuel costs (up EUR 8.4 million vs Q2 2025), full EU ETS emissions surrender (100% of CO2 equivalent vs 70% in 2025), and the 36-month charter of the Superfast IX vessel from May 2026.

Fuel costs rose by EUR 8.4 million, and Tallink’s EBITDA declined to EUR 34.3 million from EUR 37.4 million.

verified_key_information_units.information: Elenger Grupp's Q2 2026 gas and electricity sales volumes decreased by 34% to 3.3 TWh (from 4.9 TWh in Q2 2025), primarily due to reduced wholesale sales. During Q2, Elenger continued developing battery energy storage systems, with a 4.5 MW facility in Liepāja, Latvia entering commercial operation at the start of Q3 2026. Polish subsidiaries secured a EUR 60 million loan agreement to expand the Polish gas business.
